description:
A freshman at the M.M.R. Vocational School who is utterly obsessed with fashion design.
She is prone to using her phone and falling asleep in class. This behavior, which gives her a seemingly rebellious and harsh edge, disguises the fact that she is actually an emotionally sensitive person who truly cherishes her friendship with Zwei and Rei.

lines.text:
Did you call me?
What's up? I'm kinda busy listening to music.

This place is dull as dirt.
Isn't there anything fun to do around here?

I have to be honest with you, Teacher. Your outfit is a bit dated, especially the color... 
It'd be much better if they were brighter.

What type of music do you usually listen to? 
Do you wanna swap playlists?

When I become the exclusive designer for Rushae,
I'll make you the coolest outfit in town!

I can't wait to graduate so I can call you Commander too.
That'd be so badass!

Ugh, I'm so bored!
Why'd you even bother inviting me if this is all we're gonna do?!

Since you left me all alone,
you've got to go to karaoke with me when you get back. No ifs, ands, or buts!

Don't you think this place is a bit barren?
We should liven it up with a karaoke bar or something.

At least you've got a decent-sized shopping mall.
Maybe we'll find Rupee there?

Hey, teach! Have you seen any of the other students?
Pretty sure we were supposed to meet up here... or maybe not...
Teacher, it's been ages! I missed you so much, hehe!
Yahoo! I'm gonna brag about this to the others, hehe.
At this rate, I'll be able to beat Zwei pretty soon.
You didn't have to go all out like this... but thanks anyway!
You're the best, Teacher!
Oh my gosh, this is totally my style! Thanks!
If you can, try and get me something from Rushae next time.

You look particularly handsome today.
Just sayin'!
Do you think you could be our homeroom teacher?
Just wait a little longer until I graduate, hehe.
Are you really going to take me? Seriously? Wow...
Huh?
Let's go!
If we're gonna do this, might as well do it right.
Put your head right here.
Let's finish this quickly!
Time to show off my skills!
Just like how I did during practice.
Reloaded! Wasn't that cool?
Just a second, Teacher!
Why are there so many?!
What are you looking at?! Get lost!
You're all dead!
Phew, got you.
These things are so weak!
Another one bites the dust!
Ugh!
That hurt!
Ow!
Ow... That really hurts... I'm gonna head to the nurse's office...
Did you see that, Teacher? Wasn't I great?

What do you think of the outfit? I tweaked it myself.
Think it's good enough to apply to Rushae?

Did I buy too much? I'm running out of hands...
Hey, Teacher, mind carrying a few things for me?

Teacher! Come here quickly!
There's all sorts of fun things here!
It's nice to see you again, Teacher... Do you feel the same way?

If we walk around like this,
people might get the wrong idea, right? Hehe.

Let's take a picture together later!
I'm gonna go put it up in my dorm!

Where did you go, Teacher?
If you keep doing this, I'm going to go off and explore on my own!

I touched up my makeup, and my hair looks nice too.
All we need to do now is wait for Teacher to come back, hehe.

They were selling a lot of trinkets for the festival.
I really wish there was a festival every day.
Doesn't it seem like Zwei is super stoked? She's so cute.
I wonder if Rupee went to the festival?
Happy New Year, Teacher!
I'm going to beat up all my rivals!
At this rate, I'm gonna end up graduating early!

I'll protect you from here on out, Teacher!
... That sounded pretty cool, didn't it?

Oh my goodness! You didn't have to give me this.
It's a festival, so I brought some money of my own.
You shouldn't even be allowed to give me such nice things all the time!
Wow, thanks! I'll be sure to buy you something that suits you, Teacher.
How do I look? It's almost the New Year, and I feel like I've grown up a bit, don't you think?

If anyone asks for your phone number at the festival, just say you don't have a phone, okay?
Or tell them to get in line!
I wish I could just have fun with you like this every day...
Wasn't today supposed to be a festival? It's not a Rapture festival, right?!
Yep.
On my way.
So you're the ones who ruined my festival!
Let's get this over with so we can go back.
These guys are done for!
Ugh! I'm so sick of this.
Gotta use what I've learned.
Was it like this...?
Reloading!
Teacher! Me, me!
Give me back my festival!
Let's wipe them out!
I think I'm doing pretty well!
No big deal!
Don't mess with me!
Ouch!
Hey! My clothes!
Oh, come on...!
Argh... Teacher... you can't just leave me and go to the festival...

We're going back to see the festival now, aren't we?!
Not a Rapture festival, a regular festival!
